title: Remove Nth Node From End
description: Given the head of a linked list, remove the `n`th node from the end of the list and return its elements.
input_format: First line contains total nodes `len` and `n`. Second line contains the node values.

sample_tests.explanation: The 2nd node from end (4) is removed.
Removing the only node leaves empty list.

hints: Use two pointers fast and slow separated by n nodes.
Advance fast n steps ahead first.
Then advance both together until fast reaches the end; slow is right before the target node.

starter_code.python:

    data = sys.stdin.read().split()

    # Write your solution here

if __name__ == '__main__':

reference_solution:
import sys
data = sys.stdin.read().split()
if data:
    length, n = int(data[0]), int(data[1])
    vals = data[2:2+length]
    del vals[length - n]
    print(' '.join(vals))
